newsitem.title: GERMANY: Arcor says ATT Unisource investment okayed.
newsitem.headline: Arcor says ATT Unisource investment okayed.

text.p: German cartel authorities have approved investments by AT&T and Unisource in a Mannesmann consortium that holds 49.8 percent of Mannesmann Arcor AG, Arcor said on Wednesday.
Arcor says ATT Unisource investment okayed
Arcor said the formal process for the two international partners' participation had now been completed, as the European Commission had also been informed.
German railway Deutsche Bahn AG holds the controlling 50.2 percent of Mannesmann Arcor, which is Germany's second-largest supplier of communication services.
AT&T and Unisource each hold 15 percent of the Mannesmann consortium that controls the remainder. Deutsche Bank AG holds 10 percent and Mannesmann holds 60 percent.
Arcor is a private fixed-network operator with a 40,000 kilometer network. With 7,000 employees, it had sales of 900 million marks in 1996.
